# ENV004: Selected runtime is shadowed on PATH

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: path. Severity: warning.

An earlier PATH candidate takes precedence over the selected environment.

- Activate the selected environment or move its bin directory before the conflicting entry.
